notes: Recorded 26 doctoral programmes; the programmes page and the 2026-2027 deadlines table both name the same 26 academic PhD programmes (the Doctorate of Business Administration and Doctor of Pharmacy are professional doctorates, not PhDs, and are not recorded).

A separate UAEU page for the PhD Fellowship (all nationalities) requires the dissertation to fall within the UAE priority sectors (renewable energy, transportation, health, water, technology, space). That is a different fellowship page and its rule is not applied to this international-student fellowship; editors may want to confirm which rule applies.
The deadlines table spells two programme names slightly differently (Horticulture Science, Ecology and Enivornmental Sciences); the programmes page wording is used.
